in_marathi.name: Tetea
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tetea हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tetea is a Hindu name that means 'Goddess of Love and Beauty'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Triveni', which refers to the three holy rivers - Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati. Tetea is believed to bring happiness, love, and prosperity to the one who bears this name.
